Mansi Metals ERP v1.0.51:
• Granular Sub-Permissions Across All 7 Modules: Transactions, Job Work, Melting/Production, Masters, Reports, HR & Payroll, and System Settings
• Bidirectional Access Resolution: Sub-modules automatically unlock parent hub access and preserve strict sub-feature isolation
• Seamless Multi-Firm Support: Granular roles & permissions work across all allocated workspaces
